name: Assembla
summary: Assembla hosts managed Git and Subversion repositories with merge requests and code review. Starter costs $12.50 per user a month and Growth $19.00 per user a month, both shown with a yearly total. SAML 2.0 single sign-on and role-based access control are stated for all plans. IP allowlisting is listed only for some environments, so it is not claimed here.

facts.text: Assembla describes its offer as managed Subversion and Git hosting, with merge requests, rich diffs and branch locking.

On the pricing page, Starter, Growth and Custom Cloud support Subversion alongside Git and Git LFS. Its comparison table includes code review, merge requests and multi-reviewer approvals under source code management, without per-plan detail in the text.
Pricing page: Starter focuses on source code hosting only, and Growth and Custom Cloud include full project management.
Assembla states that SAML 2.0 single sign-on is supported across all plans, and that it holds a SOC 2 Type II certification.
Starter includes 10 GB of storage per user and Growth includes 50 GB per user.
The security page says customer data in EU deployments stays in Frankfurt, Germany, and that EU data residency is available.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Shown as $12.50 per user a month, with a $900.00 per year figure. The page's Annually -10% option does not say how the yearly figure is calculated

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Shown as $19.00 per user a month, with a $1,368.00 per year figure. The same Annually -10% option applies and the yearly figure is not explained

hiddenCosts: Extra storage is an add-on. The pricing page states its price in two different ways, so confirm it with sales.
The pricing page does not name its currency. The figures use the dollar sign and are recorded here as USD.

security.ssoPlan: All plans (SAML 2.0, stated on the security page)
